calculation.description: Cross-sectionally demean daily log returns, measure 40-day residual trend persistence, risk-adjust by 40-day residual volatility, then invert because persistent relative trends historically mean-revert over the subsequent 10 trading days. All inputs are lagged one completed session.

parameters.residual_definition: daily log return minus cross-sectional mean

validation.regime_notes: Positive inverse-signal IC across the full sample; underlying persistence signal was negative in 2024-2026, 2027-2029, and 2030-2032. Small cross-asset universe warrants conservative interpretation.
